chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
There is no harm if a man comes to Mecca and performs Tawaf during the days of Mina and does not stay overnight there.

key_terms.أَيَّامِ مَنًى: Days of Mina (the days of Tashriq, 11th-13th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: Can a pilgrim perform Tawaf in Mecca during the days of Mina without staying overnight in Mina?
ai.summary: In *Al-Istibsar*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling to clarify the flexibility of pilgrimage rituals during the days of Tashriq, distinguishing between the obligation to stay in Mina and the permissibility of brief visits to Mecca for voluntary Tawaf. This reflects the Shia juristic view that the prohibition of staying in Mina applies specifically to the night of the 11th, 12th, and 13th, allowing pilgrims to perform additional devotions in the Holy City without violating the core requirements of the Hajj.
